newsitem.title: USA: No special AirTouch provision in bill--aide.
newsitem.headline: No special AirTouch provision in bill--aide.

text.p: A senior congressional aide said on Tuesday that AirTouch Communications Inc's purchase of the wireless business of U S West Inc's U S West Media Group would be taxable under the tax bill agreed between the White House and congressional leaders.

San Francisco-based AirTouch announced the $5 billion purchase shortly after Congress proposed the bill that would eliminate Morris Trust tax-free provisions for certain spinoffs by publicly traded companies.
Asked by a reporter whether the AirTouch deal would be "grandfathered" under the tax bill, the congressional aide said that it would not.
The aide was speaking at a briefing on the tax bill agreed on Monday between Republican leaders in Congress and the White House.
